Script to use DDM to analyse cilia beat frequency

## Packages
```{r packages}
library(dplyr) # Pipe and data manipulation
library(ggplot2) # plotting
library(signal) # Windowing for FFT, signal processing
library(png) # Read in .png files
library(stringr) # Strip ".MOV" from file names
library(tidyr) # FOr pivot_wider function in FFT data summary
library(EBImage)     # For image processing
library(parallel)    # For parallel processing
```

## User input
```{r Set some constants}
# Directories
input_dir <- "Test_input/"
output_dir <- "Test_output/"

# Load data from pre-prepared data
load_from_rda <- TRUE

# Set video details
height <- 360
width <- 640
frame_rate <- 480
num_frames <- 512
last_frame <- 9000

# Minimum frequency threshold (Hz)
frequency_threshold <- 5
lower_threshold <- 7.7
upper_threshold <- 15.5
window_size <- 16
overlap <- 0.25
time_lags <- c(1,2,4,8)

# LUT file
LUT_file <- "lut.txt"
annotations_file <- "annotations.tsv"

# Load required functions
source("DDM_functions.R")
```

## Run the CBF analysis (DDM)
```{r DDM analysis}
# Vector for donor IDs - read from available .MOV files in input folder
donor_IDs <- list.files(input_dir) %>%
  grep(pattern = ".MOV$", value = TRUE) %>%
  str_remove(".MOV")

# Read in annotations
annotations <- read.delim(paste0(input_dir, annotations_file))

# Load the video as a 3D array
# Repeat process for each donor
for (d in donor_IDs) {
  # Print message to keep track of progress
  print(
    paste0(
      "Starting on donor ",
      d,
      ", ",
      which(donor_IDs %in% d),
      " of ",
      length(donor_IDs)
    )
  )
  
  ## Extract frames / load data ----
  if(load_from_rda) {
    # Load from prepared data
    print("Loading .rda")
    load(paste0(output_dir, "prepared_data/", d, "_3D_array.rda"))
    
  } else {
    # Read in from video data
    print("Extracting frames")
    
    # Use ffmpeg to extract frames and write to .png
    cmd <- paste0(
      "ffmpeg -i ",
      input_dir,
      d,
      ".MOV -vf \"select=between(n\\,",
      last_frame - num_frames + 1,
      "\\,",
      last_frame,
      ")\" -vsync 0 ",
      output_dir,
      "temp_frames/frame_%d.png"
    )
    system(cmd)
    
    # Initialize an empty 3D array
    video_array <- array(NA, dim = c(height, width, num_frames))
    
    # Read in .png frames and select one channel (gray scale)
    for (z in 1:num_frames) {
      #Read in the frame
      video_array[,,z] <- readPNG(paste0(output_dir, "temp_frames/frame_", z, ".png"))[,,1]
    }
    
    # Clear free space
    gc()
    
    # Save the data as a .rda file - for faster loading in future
    save(video_array, file = paste0(output_dir, "prepared_data/", d, "_3D_array.rda"))
  } # Close data loading else statement
  
  ## Preprocessing ----
  # Apply preprocessing to subtract background and smooth
  video_processed <- preprocess_video(video_array)
  
  ## Run DDM analysis ----
  # Calculate DDM structure function ----
  ddm_result <- calculate_ddm_structure_function(video_processed)
  
  # Extract frequency maps ----
  freq_maps <- extract_frequency_maps(ddm_result, frame_rate, cilia_freq_range)
  
  # Identify ciliated regions ----
  cilia_mask <- identify_ciliated_regions(freq_maps)
  
  # Calculate CBF statistics ----
  cbf_stats <- calculate_cbf_statistics(freq_maps, cilia_mask)
  
} # Close loop over donors
```
